lines.en: : Hello and welcome to the newly refurbished Amamiya family dojo!
: And a big thank you to everyone who did not follow Sensei to the date competition!
: I hope it went horribly and that he never wants to talk to either of them ever again.
: This room is much different without the Emerald Guardian screaming about her father.
: I have no idea what that means!
: We had our Halloween party here last year and Molly...got really drunk and let her Irish come out.
: Last year? But haven’t you guys only been in class together for-
: So how is this supposed to go exactly?
: The lighting is interesting, but it’s not like this is particularly scary.
: The contest hasn’t even started yet, you friggin’ nerd.
: I’m not a-
: Maya, the way it’s going to work is that you’re going to go in through the door on the left and Tsuneyo is going to go in through the door on the right.
: Behind each door is a personalized room meant to scare the pants off of both of you.
: Whoever lasts the longest in there without coming out will be the winner.
: It’s just one room?
: Yeah. I wanted to do more, but I spent my entire allowance on putting up new walls.
: Sooooo we’re going to have to settle for just one room this year.
: But that is fine! Because if your friends know anything about you, it will be a super scary room!
: Probably!
: Hopefully!
: I am already scared.
: Tsunecchi, aren’t you payin’ attention? The scary stuff hasn’t started yet.
: You’re not secretly a scaredy cat, are you?
: I have never heard of that breed before.
: It means that you’re easily frightened, Tsuneyo.
: Oh. Then no. I do not think I am that type of cat.
: I am just further away from Noodles than I have ever been before.
: You really like ramen, huh?
: Noodles is my child.
: You really like ramen, huh?
: Noodles is the bird on top of our vending machine. Tsuneyo spends a lot of time with him when she’s not busy workin’ or hangin’ out with Molly.
: I’m sure your bird is okay, Tsuneyo.
: If only his father never left. Perhaps I would feel safer.
: And I'm assuming the “father” is who I think it is, isn’t it?
: I shall win this competition and ask him to come home and reunite our family.
: So, if it’s only one room, how will we know when it’s safe to come out?
: What do you mean?
: I mean that there’s only so much you can see in one room.
: Unless it’s like...
: A really big room?
: Right. Unless it’s a really big room.
: I should have asked the Emerald Guardian to cast a warding spell on me.
: Beats me. I guess we’re just hoping that one of them is scary enough to force you guys out right away.
: And if you find yourself looking at everything and not getting scared, just...wait until we knock, I guess?
: Feel free to come out whenever you want, Maya. One more win for the second floor girls could very well be all we need to end things.
: Oooooor stay inside as long as possible so we can get Sensei in our room for the beach.
: Yes. Stay inside even if there is someone threatening to kill you.
: That wouldn’t even be a test of courage anymore. It would be a test of survival.
: A test of survival...
: So we are walking the plank...
: Only if Molly put a plank in your room, Tsunecchi.
: She’s the one that decorated yours, so if anything in there really does scare you, blame her and not us.
: And no lawsuits if you get too scared!
: By entering the scary room, you waive all of your personal freedoms and agree that you bear full responsibility for anything and everything that happens inside.
: I swear, if there is actually someone in there who is going to try and kill me, I am going to be very mad.
: I, Tsuneyo Tojo, Noodle Evil Kendo Princess and Samurai of the Old Realm, Defender of All That is Delicious-
: Wow, Tsunecchi’s title got really long all of a sudden.
: I shall destroy fear as I destroy green onions.
: I’m innocent! Don’t shoot!
: Are you ready, Maya?
: I was the one who decorated your scary room. So, even if I got everything right and you're totally terrified, try to hold out so we can win. Okay?
: Sure. Let’s just get this over with so poor Sana can calm down already.
: Yeah...I’m gonna go talk to her in a couple minutes. She seems really nervous.
: Nervous? Me? Of course not. I am a warrior. A champion.
: We're talking about Sana, Tsuneyo.
: Good luck.
: You too, bro.
Two girls in a line in a room made of lines approach a collection of lines and push them open.
Other things happen while this happens.
Here are some of them.
: Sana, as much as I want to win, I will understand if you don’t want to follow through with this.
: No one in the class would want to stand up there in front of everybody for the sake of being judged.
: Yeah, if you’re feelin’ nervous, none of us would hold it against ya. We care more about you bein’ happy than we care about sleepin’ in a room with our teacher.
: I’d feel...really bad...backing out after...Ami and Ayane spent so much of last night making the outfit for me...
: Ami...didn’t even sleep...
: She went home after the rap battle and...did her best...so...
: I have to...show everyone how hard she worked...
: I’m just...worried that...Y...Yasu will...win instead...
: You kiddin’? That creepy girl over you?
: That’s really kind of you, Sana. Following through with this for the sake of everyone else even though you don’t want to.
: But really. If it gets to be too much...just give me a signal, okay?
: I’m your captain, so it’s my job to make sure you’re feeling fine at all times.
: Yeah! You can count on Makoto!
: Besides, everybody knows Sensei likes ‘em tiny! And you’re the tiniest thing we’ve got!
: Sensei likes what, Miku?
: Nothin’! I didn’t say anything!
: Uhh...
: Go Sana! Yeah! You got this!
: Mmmmmmm.........
: I can hear the sound of your blood.
: Futaba?!
: I kinda need you over here!
: Rin...Rokuhara...
: Such a pretty name.
: Um...th...thank you?...
: How long have you been hurting?
: ...Excuse me?
: Your body.
: I can see through the fibers.
: I can see what you conceal. What others can’t.
: I...have no idea what you’re talking about.
: How long have you been hurting?...
: Then why?
: Why would you do that to yourself?
: Do...what?
: How long have you been hurting?...
: Futaba?!?! Please?!?! Some help?!?!
: I can save you...I can take the pain away...
: I just need to know...
: How long have you been hurting?...
: Molly?
: Huh? What?
: You...dare interrupt me in the middle of my evocation?
: This...transgression will not go unnoticed, you-
: Come here.
: I...beg your pardon?
: Wha-?!
: You doing okay?
: I'm...fine. What is this?
: When you’re not feeling well, you should tell someone.
: But if you don’t want to, I give you full permission to come squeeze me whenever you want. No questions asked.
: Whatever it is, it’ll be okay.
: Hang in there. You got this.
: Noriko...
: Thank you...
: Why are you so annoyingly nice to everybody?
: Fuck off, Kirin.
: Is there...no lightswitch in here?
: I've been in this stupid room for like five minutes and I still can't-
: Oh.
: I think this is it.
: What...
One girl in a room in a house on a planet in a universe.
She does not smile.
: What the fuck is this?...
Happy juice pours out of her eyes.
: What the fuck is this?!
: Where did these pictures come from?!
Seeing is believing, which is why it must be horrible to be blind.
But in some cases, being blind might be better.
For there are many different things out there that many people do not wish to see.
Are they memories?
Snapshots of the future?
Recreations of dreams?
You tell me.
What is it that scares you most?
Tell me and I will capture it.
I will cage it for you.
And together, we will observe how it reacts when it is forced to come to terms with what it fears most.
A normal [teenage]girl continues to explore her cage.
It reminds her of better days.
Or were they worse?
You tell me.

Maya wins!
: Hey! How did it go?
: Pretty scary, right?

: It was really hard thinking of stuff that might actually get to you since you never seem scared, so I kinda just threw a bunch of normal scary movie stuff in there in hopes that something would work.
: Normal...scary movie stuff?
: Yeah! You know, like...vampires and ghosts and a few of those jumpscare Halloween decorations Ayane had laying around.
: Don’t tell me you got so scared that you didn’t even get to see all of it?
: I guess I did...
: Well, Tsuneyo only lasted like 30 seconds anyway, so you pretty much demolished her.
: Molly set a trap thingy that knocked a bowl of ramen off of a shelf if Tsuneyo pushed a button and...well, you can probably guess how that ended.
: Uhh...so, anyway, we’re going to start heading over to Sana’s mom’s bar thing for the fashion show. But I kind of wanted to stop at a convenience store first and-
: I’m going to go back to the dorm, actually.
: Are you okay?...
: I know you’re probably still scared but...it seems like it might be a little worse than that...
: I need to lay down...
